name: No destructive blind replay
statement: Following crash, sleep or reboot, uncertain file operations must not silently repeat; durable receipts and reconciliation must preserve or explicitly resolve pending, partial and unknown outcomes.
changePolicy: Storage and messaging are fluid; observable idempotency and honest uncertain outcomes are fixed.

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
